subject: Item arrived damaged
message: hi, my order OS-3811230 came on New Year's Eve in the afternoon and I brought the box inside and opened it that evening, and the box didn't seem to have anything wrong with it that I could see, and then I took the plushie out of the plastic it was wrapped in and set it down on the floor to look at it, and then I saw it was ripped, with stuffing coming out. I didn't pull on it or try to push the stuffing back in or anything like that. I meant to write to you right away but with the holiday I didn't get to it until now, so I hope that's okay. There's a picture attached. I would like a refund please, I don't really want to try another one after this one came like this. If you need it sent back I still have the box and the plastic and everything it came with, I just need to know what to do next. The order number again is OS-3811230. Thank you, Kevin
